title: 开路线和短路线：测出特性阻抗
statement: 同一种无损耗电缆截取两段，长度都是 l = 0.3 m，相速 v_p = 2×10⁸ m/s，在 f = 100 MHz 下测输入阻抗：上面一段终端开路，下面一段终端短路，都用 1∠0° V（有效值）的电源从始端激励。
（电缆的 Z_c 已画在图上，供校核；要求先用 Z_c 算出两个输入阻抗，再假装只知道测量值，反求 Z_c 和电长度。）

questions.ask: 终端开路时的输入阻抗 Z_oc 的虚部 = ?
终端短路时的输入阻抗 Z_sc 的虚部 = ?
questions.explain: Z_sc = jZ_c tan βl = j60 × 1.3764 = j82.58 Ω（感性）。

questions.ask: 只根据这两个测量值求特性阻抗 Z_c = √(Z_ocZ_sc) = ?
questions.explain: Z_ocZ_sc = (−jZ_c cot βl)(jZ_c tan βl) = Z_c²，所以 Z_c = √(43.59 × 82.58) = 60 Ω——这是测量电缆特性阻抗的标准方法。

questions.ask: 再由 tan βl = √(−Z_sc/Z_oc) 求这段线的电长度 l/λ = ?
要用一段终端短路的 60 Ω 线得到一个电容（容抗 60 Ω），线长应取多少？
choiceExplain: λ/4 短路线的输入阻抗为无穷大（相当于开路）。
questions.explain: Z_sc = jZ_c tan βl 要等于 −j60，tan βl = −1，βl = 135°，l = 3λ/8。短路线在 λ/4 < l < λ/2 时呈容性。

hints: 终端开路 İ_2 = 0，短路 V̇_2 = 0，代入无损耗线方程 V̇_1 = V̇_2 cos βl + jZ_cİ_2 sin βl、İ_1 = jV̇_2 sin βl/Z_c + İ_2 cos βl。
得到 Z_oc = −jZ_c cot βl、Z_sc = jZ_c tan βl。两式相乘消去 βl，相除消去 Z_c。
solution: **检查：** 43.59 × 82.58 = 3600 = 60² ✓。有损耗线同样成立：Z_c = √(Z_ocZ_sc)、tanh γl = √(Z_sc/Z_oc)。

en.title: Open and shorted lines: measuring the characteristic impedance
statement: Two pieces are cut from the same lossless cable, both l = 0.3 m long, phase velocity v_p = 2×10⁸ m/s. Their input impedances are measured at f = 100 MHz: the upper piece has its end open, the lower one has its end shorted; both are driven at the start by 1∠0° V (rms).
(The cable's Z_c is shown in the drawing for checking. First compute the two input impedances from Z_c, then pretend only the measured values are known and recover Z_c and the electrical length.)

questions.ask: Imaginary part of the input impedance with the end open, Z_oc = ?
questions.explain: Z_oc = −jZ_c cot βl with βl = 2π × 0.3/2 = 54°: Z_oc = −j60 × 0.7265 = −j43.59 Ω (capacitive).

questions.ask: Imaginary part of the input impedance with the end shorted, Z_sc = ?
questions.explain: Z_sc = jZ_c tan βl = j60 × 1.3764 = j82.58 Ω (inductive).

questions.ask: From the two measurements only: Z_c = √(Z_ocZ_sc) = ?
questions.explain: Z_ocZ_sc = (−jZ_c cot βl)(jZ_c tan βl) = Z_c², so Z_c = √(43.59 × 82.58) = 60 Ω — the standard way to measure a cable's characteristic impedance.

questions.ask: Then from tan βl = √(−Z_sc/Z_oc), the electrical length l/λ = ?
To get a capacitor (reactance 60 Ω) from a shorted 60 Ω line, how long must it be?
questions.explain: Z_sc = jZ_c tan βl must equal −j60: tan βl = −1, βl = 135°, l = 3λ/8. A shorted line is capacitive for λ/4 < l < λ/2.
choiceExplain: A shorted λ/4 line has an infinite input impedance (it looks like an open circuit).

hints: Open end: İ_2 = 0; shorted end: V̇_2 = 0. Put them into the lossless line equations V̇_1 = V̇_2 cos βl + jZ_cİ_2 sin βl, İ_1 = jV̇_2 sin βl/Z_c + İ_2 cos βl.
This gives Z_oc = −jZ_c cot βl and Z_sc = jZ_c tan βl. Their product eliminates βl, their ratio eliminates Z_c.
solution: **1. Electrical length.** λ = v_p/f = 2 m, βl = 2π × 0.3/2 = 0.3π = 54°.
**2. Open end.** İ_2 = 0: Z_oc = V̇_1/İ_1 = −jZ_c cot βl = **−j43.59 Ω** (l < λ/4: capacitive).
**3. Shorted end.** V̇_2 = 0: Z_sc = jZ_c tan βl = **j82.58 Ω** (l < λ/4: inductive).
**Check:** 43.59 × 82.58 = 3600 = 60² ✓. The same holds on a lossy line: Z_c = √(Z_ocZ_sc), tanh γl = √(Z_sc/Z_oc).
